text:
Maya: Postmortem follow-up for the KV-cache OOM series. We need a short, actionable checklist and owners. I want weekly rollups until the metrics show steady state.

Ethan: I can take the instrumentation work - add allocation-site labels to the pprof exports and wire a dashboard. ETA: 72h.

Ravi: I’ll own the GC tuning matrix and the canary plan. Draft: try conservative GC aggressive sweep every 10s on canary shard, and test slab split threshold from 256KB -> 64KB.

June: I’ll implement the emergency limiter: pre-evict policy that prefers low-hit prefixes, with a fastpath that avoids compaction during eviction. ETA: 48h.

Maya: Can we enumerate discrete actions that go into the postmortem action table? Keep items small so we can close them quickly.

Ethan: Action A (owner: Ethan) - add "alloc_site" tag to heap samples, publish dashboard showing top 20 alloc sites by week. ETA: 72h.

Ravi: Action B (owner: Ravi) - run slab-split canary, measure fragmentation ratio, and report CPU/RSS tradeoffs. Schedule: start canary in staging tomorrow morning for 48h.

June: Action C (owner: June) - implement pre-evict logic + opt-out annotation for noisy prefixes, add unit tests for compaction concurrency. ETA: 48h.

Maya: Action D (owner: Maya) - set up weekly digest and sprint tickets, contact customers impacted with ETA and mitigation notes. ETA: 5 business days.

Ethan: Small note - I found a consistent pattern in the pprof: many short-lived allocations in kvcache.fetchPrefix leading to fragmentation when combined with large cold items. Snippet:
```
# summary
kvcache.fetchPrefix
kvcache.entryInsert
runtime.mallocgc
runtime.heapBitsSet
```

ops-bot: new alert rule created: kvcache_frag_churn - triggers when churn_rate > 0.18 for 2h on any shard.

Maya: Good. Add metadata tags to the alert: deployment, shard, prefix_hash. Also make the alert annotate the last 3 restarts.

ci-bot: canary deployment started: canary-shard-3 (slab_split=64KB, gc_interval=10s) - build 2026.4.11-rc12.

Ravi: I’ll instrument a GC metric (last_full_sweep_seconds) so we can correlate sweep frequency with RSS growth.

June: For runbook: if an alert fires twice in 24h on same shard -> auto-snoop job runs to collect a 30s perf trace and open an incident ticket. I’ll draft the runbook steps.

Maya: Who will do weekly check-ins? Need somebody to rotate and summarize progress and blockers.

Ravi: I can take the next two rotations. Will post minutes and attach results.

Ethan: Uploading baseline heap captures now. s3://redwood-profiles/1968129999/baseline-heap-ethan-1.pb.gz

ops-bot: detected OOM candidate on shard-12 at 2026-11-10T21:03:07Z - pid 4821 exited 137 - log s3://incidents/1968129999/oom-shard12.log

Maya: Thanks everyone. Please update the postmortem doc with PR links and mark the action items when done. We’ll review in the Wed ops sync. :heart:
